purpose: Defines the fields, preconditions, and structure of the 'Imaging Modality Selection' screen within workflow WF_001.
preconditions: Patient identification has been completed on the prior screen
postconditions: All required fields on 'Imaging Modality Selection' are captured and saved before advancing to the next screen.
validations: Confirm selected modality matches the ordering physician's request
Confirm laterality (left/right/bilateral) is specified where applicable
Confirm a clinical indication is documented before proceeding
common_errors: Laterality left blank for a paired body region
Modality selected does not match the order
